decks.notes: The focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent using aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while controlling the board with efficient counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to maintain tempo using spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to efficiently remove threats from the opponent's board. The inclusion of cards like Expressive Iteration and Consider allow for card advantage and selection. Overall, this deck aims to be quick, disruptive, and adaptable in order to quickly overwhelm the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using cheap and efficient burn spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Rift Bolt. The deck also includes creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear to keep up the pressure. With a mix of direct damage spells, efficient creatures, and a few utility spells like Boros Charm and Roiling Vortex, this deck aims to end the game as quickly as possible before the opponent has a chance to stabilize or gain control.

This deck relies on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Expedition Map to search for key pieces and control the board with cards like Oblivion Stone and Dismember. The deck also includes powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to close out the game. Karn, the Great Creator is used to shut down opponents' artifacts, while Walking Ballista and Wurmcoil Engine provide additional threats. Abundant Harvest and Boseiju, Who Endures help to ensure consistency and protection.

This deck focuses on controlling the game with a mix of counterspells, removal, and powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Sheoldred. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells, while also using powerful creatures to apply pressure and win the game. Additionally, the inclusion of "The One Ring" card adds a unique element to the deck, allowing for additional control and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through careful decision-making and resource management.

The main concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent through a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells. The deck focuses on using efficient cards such as Fatal Push and Solitude to control the board while deploying powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Samwise the Stouthearted to quickly close out the game. Additionally, using cards like Feign Death and Ephemerate allows for extra value by reusing key creatures or disrupting the opponent's game plan. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's strategy and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Amulet of Vigor to cheat out powerful creatures like Primeval Titan. The combo involves fetching specific lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion with the help of Primeval Titan to deal lethal damage to the opponent. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility with artifacts and Urza's Saga can help search for key pieces. The deck aims to win the game through explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent with its powerful threats.

The main focus of this deck is to deal quick and direct damage to the opponent using efficient and aggressive red spells and creatures. The deck includes a variety of burn spells like Lava Spike, Lightning Bolt, and Searing Blaze, as well as fast creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The goal is to maintain pressure on the opponent and prevent them from stabilizing, ultimately winning the game through consistent and relentless aggression. The deck also includes cards like Skullcrack and Boros Charm to protect against life gain strategies and close out games quickly.

This deck focuses on aggressively disrupting the opponent's hand and board state through a combination of discard spells like Thoughtseize, disruptive creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and powerful removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push. The deck also employs cards like Grief and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to disrupt the opponent's strategy and apply pressure. The goal is to maintain control of the game while applying pressure and finishing off the opponent quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent using aggressive creatures and burn spells. By efficiently managing resources and maximizing damage output, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or mount a defense. The deck aims to maintain pressure and prevent the opponent from gaining life or stabilizing their board through efficient removal and direct damage spells. The strategy is to be proactive, fast, and relentless in attacking the opponent's life total, often winning before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The key strategy involves ramping up mana with cards like Dwarven Mine and Leyline Binding, while also controlling the board with spells like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponents, while Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and recursion. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Karn, the Great Creator, along with removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. It also utilizes cards like Leyline Binding and The One Ring to lock down opponents' options. The deck ramps up its mana with Utopia Sprawl and lands like Boseiju, Who Endures, enabling it to cast threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and close out the game. The inclusion of versatile cards like Ancient Stirrings and Fury adds flexibility to the deck's game plan.

This deck utilizes a toolbox strategy, utilizing creatures with various abilities to create combos and generate value. It focuses on using cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for key pieces, such as Academy Manufactor and Chatterfang, Squirrel General. By utilizing cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Witch's Oven, the deck can generate multiple tokens and create powerful synergies. The inclusion of cards like Urza's Saga and Gilded Goose help to accelerate the deck's game plan and create an advantage over the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful planeswalkers (Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six), removal spells (Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat), and lock pieces (Karn, the Great Creator and Leyline Binding). The deck also utilizes ramp (Utopia Sprawl and Nissa, Resurgent Animist) to quickly get to its top-end threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and The One Ring. The mana base is optimized for consistency and the inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures helps the deck fight against counterspells and other control decks.

This Modern Amulet Titan deck focuses on quickly ramping mana with land bounce effects and Amulet of Vigor to cheat out big creatures like Primeval Titan. The main goal is to assemble the key lands Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Primeval Titan to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Urza's Saga and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to generate more value and speed up the combo. Overall, this deck seeks to overwhelm opponents with a powerful combo strategy that can quickly close out games.

The deck focuses on establishing control over the game by utilizing various spells and powerful creatures. It aims to control the board state, generate card advantage, and disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck includes versatile removal spells, powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler, and Wrenn and Six, as well as strong creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation. By effectively managing resources and deploying threats strategically, the deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through attrition and overwhelming board presence.

Utilizing fast, aggressive creatures alongside disruptive spells, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. The deck focuses on early aggression with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while also disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize. Cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt help to remove any threats on the board, allowing the deck to push through for a quick victory. Additionally, utilizing cards like Blood Moon and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can further disrupt the opponent's strategy and give this deck an edge in the match.
